encounters.resistances: Jadeplume Terrorshroom: Physical, Pyro, Hydro, Electro, Cryo, Anemo, Geo 25%; Dendro 80%. Weak: Physical, Pyro, Hydro, Electro, Cryo, Anemo, Geo 0%; Dendro 55%.

encounters.mechanics:

encounters.requirements:
Clear: protect the Ley Line Monolith through a 3m 10s countdown; each defeat removes 15s.
Star Challenge: finish with at least 35% monolith HP.
Active enemies: 2.
encounters.mechanics:
Monolith Defense: Draw melee Warriors toward your character and away from the monolith. Approach ranged attackers instead of letting them fire freely while you chase melee enemies.
Qucusaurus Warriors: Approaching Blazing Sky can stop her sustained projectile attack. Heartstar Hammer can leap away after an explosive strike, so avoid letting it draw your team far from the monolith.
Control: Watch Flowing Skyfire's ranged attacks and Shard Striker's Geo slams. Grouping, taunts, or Freeze can help control the attackers while protecting the monolith.

encounters.name: Defense Sequence · Landcruisers and Oprichniki
encounters.resistances:
Oprichniki Grenadier: Physical -20%.
Oprichniki Bombardier: Physical -20%.
encounters.requirements:
Clear: protect the Ley Line Monolith through a 3m 20s countdown; each defeat removes 20s.
Star Challenge: finish with at least 35% monolith HP.
Active enemies: 2.
encounters.mechanics:
Cutting Edge Landcruisers: During their kuuvahki-powered barrages, trigger Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged four times to interrupt and paralyze them. Kuuvahki can also interrupt them. The All-Purpose Storm variant can be interrupted the same way during its powered melee sequence.
Monolith Defense: Interrupt the large machines before their sustained fire builds up. Move toward ranged Oprichniki and draw melee threats away from the monolith rather than allowing both groups to attack it undisturbed.

encounters.name: High-Pressure Defense · Ruin machines
encounters.resistances:
Ruin Guard: Physical 70%.
Ruin Grader: Physical 70%.
Ruin Scout: Physical 50%.
Ruin Destroyer: Physical 30%.
Ruin Defender: Physical 50%.
Ruin Cruiser: Physical 30%.
encounters.requirements:
Clear: protect the Ley Line Monolith through a 3m 20s countdown; each defeat removes 20s.
Star Challenge: finish with at least 35% monolith HP.
Active enemies: 2 or 3.
encounters.mechanics:
Ruin Guard: Hit its exposed eye or rear core twice to paralyze it. Keep clear of its advancing spin.
Ruin Grader: Strike glowing ankle and eye weak points when exposed. Disabling both systems fully paralyzes it. Stay reasonably close to discourage its long charge, and avoid drawing a charge through the monolith.
Sentinels: Hit exposed cores twice to disable them. The Scout exposes its core before a headbutt; the Destroyer exposes it during beam-field and vacuum attacks. Move around a Defender's frontal shield rather than attacking into it.

encounters.name: Normal · Ruin Sentinels
encounters.resistances:
Ruin Scout: Physical 50%.
Ruin Cruiser: Physical 30%.
Ruin Defender: Physical 50%.
Ruin Destroyer: Physical 30%.
encounters.requirements:
Clear: defeat at least 7 opponents within 2m.
Star Challenge: defeat 9 opponents.
Active enemies: 2.
encounters.mechanics:
Weak Points: Each Sentinel can be disabled by hitting its exposed core twice. The Scout exposes its core before its headbutt, the Cruiser during several charged shots, and the Destroyer during beam-field and vacuum attacks.
Defender: Its raised shield blocks attacks from the front. Reposition to its side or rear rather than spending your damage window against the shield.
Positioning: Cruisers retreat when approached and Destroyers can burrow before reappearing nearby. Keep several machines within your area damage to progress the defeat quota instead of chasing one across the arena.

encounters.resistances:
Hydro Mimic Boar: Physical, Electro, Cryo, Dendro, Anemo, Geo 15%; Pyro -40%; Hydro immune.
Hydro Mimic Crane: Physical, Pyro, Cryo, Dendro, Anemo, Geo 15%; Hydro immune; Electro -40%.
Hydro Mimic Squirrel: Physical, Electro, Cryo, Dendro, Anemo, Geo 15%; Pyro -40%; Hydro immune.
Hydro Mimic Mallard: Physical, Pyro, Electro, Dendro, Anemo, Geo 15%; Hydro immune; Cryo -40%.
Hydro Mimic Finch: Physical, Pyro, Electro, Cryo, Dendro, Anemo 15%; Hydro immune; Geo -40%.
Hydro Mimic Crab: Physical, Pyro, Electro, Dendro, Anemo, Geo 15%; Hydro immune; Cryo -40%.
Hydro Mimic Frog: Physical, Pyro, Electro, Cryo, Dendro, Anemo 15%; Hydro immune; Geo -40%.
encounters.requirements:
Clear: defeat at least 20 opponents within 2m.
Star Challenge: defeat 24 opponents.
Active enemies: 3.
encounters.mechanics:
Innate Hydro: Electro attacks can trigger Electro-Charged and Lunar-Charged using the Mimics' own Hydro status. Bring damage sources that can defeat them rather than relying on Hydro damage.
Boars: Regenerate health repeatedly. Commit enough damage to finish a target instead of leaving several wounded Boars alive. Pyro hits briefly suppress this regeneration if you can apply Pyro.
Finches and Frogs: Leave a large water bomb when defeated. Move away from the death location while attacking the next target instead of standing beside the bomb waiting for another spawn.

encounters.name: Elite Assault · Kairagi and Nobushi
encounters.resistances:
Kairagi: Fiery Might: Physical -20%.
Kairagi: Dancing Thunder: Physical -20%.
Nobushi: Hitsukeban: Physical -20%.
Nobushi: Kikouban: Physical -20%.
encounters.requirements:
Clear: defeat at least 12 opponents within 2m.
Star Challenge: defeat 15 opponents.
Active enemies: 3.
encounters.mechanics:
Kairagi Pair: When one dies, a surviving Kairagi can enter its revenge state, recover 50% of its Max HP, gain interruption resistance, and become immune to Freeze and petrification. When a pair is active, lower both together and try to finish them close together.
Positioning: Sword charges can carry them past you. Fight near ranged Nobushi and let the melee enemies close in so your area damage reaches several targets.
Guarding: A Kairagi can block attacks from the front with its sword. Reposition rather than committing your main damage into the guard.
encounters.stageEffects: Desolation sends a Dendro cluster after characters. On contact it damages characters or enemies; it shrinks and speeds up over time.

encounters.name: Climactic Showdown · Whisperer of Nightmares
encounters.resistances: Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares: Weak: all damage types -60%.
encounters.requirements:
Clear: defeat all opponents within 1m 50s.
Star Challenge: finish within 1m 15s.
encounters.mechanics:
Deepdark Shield: The boss moves to the center and creates a shield worth 45% of its Max HP. Only elemental and reaction damage reduces it; Physical damage does not. Lunar Reaction damage deals 3 times its normal damage to the shield.
Fishers: Four appear during the charge. Each defeated Fisher removes 25% of the boss's shield, so defeating all four can break it without directly attacking the boss. Grouping and area damage help clear them quickly.
Shield Break: Breaking it before the charge finishes deals 20% of the boss's Max HP to it, defeats surviving Fishers, and reduces all RES by 70%. Save damage for the weakened window. If the shield remains, it consumes its Fishers and releases a powerful arena-wide attack.
The Stygian Onslaught energy-return mechanic does not apply here.

encounters.mechanics:
Deepdark Shield: The boss moves to the center and creates a shield worth 45% of its Max HP. Only elemental and reaction damage reduces it; Physical damage does not. Lunar Reaction damage deals 3 times its normal damage to the shield.
Fishers: Four appear during the charge. Each defeated Fisher removes 25% of the boss's shield, so defeating all four can break it without directly attacking the boss. Grouping and area damage help clear them quickly.
Shield Break: Breaking it before the charge finishes deals 20% of the boss's Max HP to it, defeats surviving Fishers, and reduces all RES by 70%. Save damage for the weakened window. If the shield remains, it consumes its Fishers and releases a powerful arena-wide attack.
The Stygian Onslaught energy-return mechanic does not apply here.

encounters.mechanics:
